items.html: No external / process gates — MVP-critical (v1 validation.required, meta_review_approve_required, command exit-code gates); the inline process execution model is → L2a, while deferred execution (WAITING(gate_pending) + GATE_RESULT) is a separate later lifecycle slice
No route verdict / workflow redirection — a gate may only allow, warn, or block, not redirect the target (meta-review auto-rework, human gate) → routing slice / L3

No gate-private mutable state — gates are stateless over config + projection + evidence refs; cross-round counters are derived, never gate-owned. A gate returning state the kernel persists and re-passes is a future idea, only with a concrete use case → later
No actor-facing communication of gate rules — the reviewer is not yet told "no CONVERGED before round 2" in its packet, so it can still burn an emit on a block → L2b
No findings vocabulary — structured finding claim/parity and P0/P1 blocker grades, which several v1 convergence checks need → later
No broad declarative DSL — only threshold in the baseline (required_previous_event next); no general query language → later
No dynamic module loading — packaged gates ship with pairflow; the external process interface is the only extension seam (not an MVP TS plugin loader) → L2a
